EmailTemplate.description: Confirmation email sent to applicant when membership application is submitted
EmailTemplate.name: CVMA Membership Application Confirmation
EmailTemplate.subject: CVMA Membership Application Received - Application #{!Membership_Application__c.Name}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Membership_Application__c.Applicant_First_Name__c},
Thank you for submitting your application to join the Combat Veterans Motorcycle Association (CVMA) Chapter 20-7 in Jacksonville, FL.
APPLICATION DETAILS: - Application ID: {!Membership_Application__c.Name} - Submitted: {!Membership_Application__c.Application_Date__c} - Membership Level: {!Membership_Application__c.Membership_Level__c} - Chapter: {!Membership_Application__c.Chapter_Preference__c}
WHAT HAPPENS NEXT: • Our officers will review your application within 3-5 business days • You may be contacted for additional information if needed • You will be notified of the decision via email • If approved, you will receive your membership ID and welcome package
CONTACT INFORMATION: If you have any questions about your application, please contact us at: Email: membership@cvma20-7.org Phone: (904) 555-CVMA
Thank you for your interest in joining our brotherhood of combat veterans.
Vets Serving Vets Combat Veterans Motorcycle Association Chapter 20-7 - Jacksonville, FL
This is an automated message. Please do not reply to this email.
